marta: Quick sync: proposing "progress pulses" for long streaming responses so the edge can checkpoint and request delta resumes instead of full replays. Short pulses = seq + resume_token + visible_offset.
oli: How do we keep duplicates out when a resumed tail arrives?
reza: Also: memory footprint at 40k concurrent streams?
marta: Plan: gateway stores only last seq+token per stream (O(1)). Tokens are opaque HMAC blobs with expiry. On resume, upstream verifies token and returns only new tokens. If verification fails, gateway starts a hedged fresh request and circuit-breaks if retries spike.
oli: Transport: gRPC needs a small framed control message; HTTP chunking can carry meta headers. We should spec both.
reza: Billing/metrics: pulses are metadata (no token billing). Add metrics: pulse_emitted, resume_attempt, resume_ok, resume_fail, duplicate_detected.
ci-bot: rollout: pulse-proto feature-flag enabled in staging on 2024-09-28T09:04Z.
marta: Next: perf sims (RTT/production load) and RFC appendix with example frames & router policies (prefer_hedge|prefer_restart). I'll prototype on dedicate runtime.
oli: +1 re perf sims. reza: +1
